messages.text: Anyone else getting kicked out of the WireRoom console? SSO login just spins and then throws a 502. Tried two browsers.
Same here. Got in 10 min ago, session dropped, now I can't re-auth. Two wires sitting in the queue waiting for release.
Heads up, not just us. Someone on the trading side said their OMS login is failing too. Looks like AuthSSO.
Acknowledged, looking at AuthSSO now. Seeing elevated 5xx on the IdP pods and token validation latency spiking. Calling this SEV2 for now. Will update here.
Thanks Barbara. Did anything deploy to AuthSSO this afternoon? Checking the change calendar on my side too.
Yes, cert rotation on the LDAP connector went out at 14:40. Two of four IdP pods are failing health checks on the new trust chain. Rolling those back now.
Is there anything we can do in the meantime? We have time-sensitive wires with a 16:30 cutoff for the Fed.
Greg, hold off on any workarounds. Don't use shared creds. If you still have an active session, finish releasing those wires with your normal dual-approval. We'll tell you the moment login is back.
Understood. My session is still live, so I can release the two queued wires with Derrick as second approver.
Rollback complete, all four IdP pods healthy. Token latency back to baseline. Can you all try logging in again?
Logged in fine on WireRoom and OMS. Greg and Mike's wires are released well before cutoff. Looks good from the wire room side.
Resolved. Impact window was roughly 15:00 to 15:27 ET. Barbara will write the postmortem on the cert rotation, and we'll re-test it in staging with the full trust chain before retrying. Thanks all.
